plainTranslation: The Saturn person can help the Sun person organize their life and follow through, while the Sun person gives warmth to Saturn's steadiness. This is useful when both people choose respect over correction. It supports long-term effort without needing to become heavy.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is leaving that potential unused. You may recognize that this person could help you grow, yet avoid the commitment, honesty, or effort needed to deepen the connection.
advice: Meet the seriousness with your own. Show up consistently. Say what you mean. Follow through. This connection becomes truly grounding when both people choose to build something real instead of simply hoping it will happen.
